reglages.intro: What you set here applies to the site. Every change is recorded in the log.

nomSite.aide: 1 to 60 characters. It appears in the header, the footer and the page titles.

numeroWhatsapp.aide: International format: the + sign then 8 to 15 digits, for example +243 970 000 000. Leave empty to clear it.

forfaitGoma.aide: Amount in US dollars, from 0 to 1000, two decimals at most, for example 5 or 5.50. 0 means free delivery. Leave empty to clear it.

forfaitBukavu.aide: Amount in US dollars, from 0 to 1000, two decimals at most, for example 8 or 8.50. 0 means free delivery. Leave empty to clear it.

delais.aide: For information: these times are fixed and cannot be set here.
delais.goma: Goma: delivered in less than a day.
delais.bukavu: Bukavu: delivered in one day at most.

retraitFr.libelle: Free pickup place in Goma, in French
retraitFr.aide: 1 to 500 characters: the address or directions the customer will see. Leave empty to clear it.

retraitEn.libelle: Free pickup place in Goma, in English
retraitEn.aide: 1 to 500 characters: the same place, in English. Leave empty to clear it.

plafond.aide: Whole number of pieces, from 1 to 10000, that you can make at the same time. It is never shown to customers. Leave empty to clear it.

erreurs.nom_invalide: The name must be 1 to 60 characters long.
erreurs.numero_invalide: The number must start with + and contain 8 to 15 digits.
erreurs.forfait_goma_invalide: The Goma fee must be an amount in USD from 0 to 1000, with two decimals at most.
erreurs.forfait_bukavu_invalide: The Bukavu fee must be an amount in USD from 0 to 1000, with two decimals at most.
erreurs.retrait_fr_invalide: The French pickup place must be 500 characters at most.
erreurs.retrait_en_invalide: The English pickup place must be 500 characters at most.
erreurs.plafond_invalide: The cap must be a whole number from 1 to 10000.
erreurs.non_autorise: You no longer have the right to change this setting. Reload the page or sign in again.
erreurs.generique: The setting could not be saved. Your entry is kept: try again.

tranches.aide: The ranges are used as the price filter in the catalogues, in list order. 8 ranges at most. Without any range, the catalogue has no price filter.
tranches.hautAide: Leave empty for an open range (no upper limit).
tranches.limite: You have reached the limit of {nombre} ranges.

erreurs.tranche_libelle_invalide: the label must be 1 to 40 characters long.
erreurs.tranche_bornes_invalides: the bounds must be amounts in USD (two decimals at most) and the upper bound must be higher than the lower bound.
